name: quick-reply
description: One-click replies above the prompt: the options Claude just offered, Yes, Go with your recommendation, Continue, Pass, Fail and Skip when Claude asks for a verdict, and the next wayfinder ticket.

questionReplies.title: Replies to a question
questionReplies.description: Shown after Claude asks something, separated by |.

idleReplies.title: Replies otherwise
idleReplies.description: Shown after any other answer, separated by |; empty hides the band then.

wayfinderNext.title: Offer the next wayfinder ticket
wayfinderNext.description: After a wayfinder turn closes a ticket or charts a map, the band offers Next ticket: one press runs /clear, then /wayfinder with the map.
